observation: Asphalt parking area opening into the narrower seaward aisle. Fence and tall tree screening line the opposite side, with the sea visible at the far end.

observation: A second view of the parking junction and the straight aisle toward the sea. Perpendicular bays meet the junction; the right edge has a low white curb, chain-link screening and mature trees. House-side planting and lanterns help identify the opposite footpath.

title: Pintor Dalí: seaward parking row and chain-link fence

title: Pintor Dalí: houses, lamps and parking bays
observation: Closer view of the house-side parking row toward the sea. A tall black lantern, white plaster frontages, projecting entrance surrounds, clipped shrubs, flowering climbers and a palm sit behind the marked bays. This photo is useful for facade and planting materials.

title: Pintor Dalí: flagstone pedestrian entrance
observation: Looking into a pedestrian lane between the houses from the roadside parking. Irregular pale stone paving contrasts with Cervantes’ square terracotta tiles. White curbs separate the entrance from the asphalt and narrow lawns; a tall black lantern, brown shutters, window grilles and flowering climbers frame the route.

title: Pintor Dalí seaward end: turning area and fence
observation: The asphalt aisle reaches a wider end area beside the sea. Parked cars remain on the left and clipped screening on the right. A low white wall with dark metal mesh, no-parking signs and a modern flat-headed lamp separates the vehicle area from the paseo/shore beyond.

title: Pintor Dalí seaward end: wall and paseo boundary
observation: A closer view of the widened asphalt end area, facing the sea. The low white wall and metal mesh form the frontage boundary; a modern slim lamp and no-parking signs are visible. A pedestrian opening is at the right-hand end; this is not an uninterrupted solid perimeter.

title: Pintor Dalí: raised stone approach and archway
observation: A raised flagstone approach leads through an arched passage in the white building. Several shallow steps are visible at the foot between flared white curbs; the passage has patterned paving, lanterns and a gate visible beyond. Dark louvred shutters and a barrel-tile canopy sit above the arch. This is a separate access from the Cervantes ramp and the big-pool steps.
locationBasis: Phone GPS, user street identification and checked street layout; camera position retained without snapping

title: Pintor Dalí: pedestrian gate to the paseo
observation: Detail of the seaward boundary’s narrow metal pedestrian gate between white walls. Adjacent rigid metal mesh allows a view of the beach and sea; a modern lamp stands beyond. The road edge has a yellow-painted curb, terracotta edging tiles, clipped shrubs and a no-parking sign. The gate provides a specific reference for the pedestrian connection.
